lessons: Attempt 0 stopped incomplete with nothing committed (empty diff_stat). It ran the whole integration suite, which the ticket never asks for. Run only the ticket's ## Verification command, read any failure and fix it, then commit. Another worktree's test process is not a reason to stop.

Redo from the merge base: add one approval-selection function in clutch/requisition.py. It reads only the latest requisition_verdict for the stem and reuses it only if it is an approval whose input_identity matches review_input_identity. A missing, null or mismatched identity means a fresh review.

In clutch/__main__.py::_review, call the selector with config.routing_default_tier before the provider is built or preflighted. In clutch/runner.py::drive, replace the ticket-SHA-only check with the same selector at capability(ticket, history)[0]. Keep admission refusal and provisional precedence.

In tests/integration/test_ladder.py, insert a requisition verdict() approve before the next agent() wherever the reviewer tier changes: retry-wall, rework-escalation, escalation-rung and operator-confirm reset. Also update the SHA-only bypass test in tests/integration/test_requisition_gate.py.

Add tests/unit/test_review_reuse_cli.py, tests/unit/test_review_reuse_dispatch.py and tests/integration/test_requisition_reuse.py with zero-provider-call assertions. Update the help text, the clutch/docs/host-running.md verb row and docs/how-clutch-works.md section 3.
